offering_description.value: Operates acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities and outpatient services that treat patients in the US and UK. Patients, insurers and government programs pay for care delivered in its owned facilities.

primary_services.value: acute care hospital services; behavioral health treatment; emergency care; outpatient and ambulatory care

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients receiving hospital, emergency and behavioral health care; B2B: commercial health insurers and managed care plans paying for patient care; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs paying for patient care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurers and patients for hospital and clinic care

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers hospital and behavioral health care, billing payers and patients for treatment; asset operator: owns and runs hospitals and treatment facilities, selling bed days and procedures to patients and payers

geography_served.value: global: US states nationwide, plus behavioral health hospitals in the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities and outpatient services sharing patients and referral networks

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities and outpatient clinics; other: physician referrals and emergency department admissions

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hospital and facility licensing by state health departments, plus Medicare and Medicaid certification rules from CMS
